items.title: Arthur Vigne Interview, 1961-11-29
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] I think he was little. It was Albert Glenn, he died. Old man Glenn, that's him. [INTERVIEWEE] Old Albert Glenn.

ctx.x: Oh he lived right down in the Tramie here. What's that man's name, I can't call it. He's an old time, he come up with my dad.
I think he was little. It was Albert Glenn, he died. Old man Glenn, that's him.
